# Veloxitas

> Veloxitas is a Dubai-based strategy practice founded by Yasmin Khataie. It helps established B2B organisations whose marketing has stopped working, or who are ready to change how they're seen, across the UAE, the wider GCC and Australia.

## What Veloxitas does
- Listen: the company's story, people and direction
- Diagnose: where the company is not seen or is misunderstood, and why
- Narrative: a clear story that means something to the people it needs to reach
- System: who delivers it, where, when and how, with optional execution directed through a specialist network

## What Veloxitas helps with
- [Narrative Clarity Diagnostic](https://veloxitas.com/narrative-clarity-diagnostic/): finds out why an established company's marketing has stopped working, and what to fix first
- [B2B marketing strategy](https://veloxitas.com/b2b-marketing-strategy/): a clear marketing direction and a system the company's team or agency can deliver
- [Entering a new market](https://veloxitas.com/new-market-positioning/): positioning and narrative for being seen and trusted by decision-makers in the GCC, Australia or another new market
- [Repositioning](https://veloxitas.com/repositioning/): changing how the market sees a company that has grown, changed direction or outgrown its image
- [Brand narrative](https://veloxitas.com/b2b-brand-narrative/): a core story and messaging that help B2B companies be understood, not just seen

## Main engagement
- Narrative Clarity Diagnostic: a structured assessment of how a company is seen, understood and chosen by its target market, with a prioritised roadmap
